Bull call spreads to act on: 0

From the IV agent’s late-morning screen run (11:01). Rule: Bull options-flow bias, explode score ≥ 60, market odds of profit ≥ 60% (breakeven at or below today’s price), max gain ≥ 0.5× risk, both legs liquid; up to 5 by bias, $2,000 max loss each. Probabilities are the options market’s own odds, so expected payoff is about the cost: higher odds come with a smaller win. The most any spread can lose is its debit. ⚠ = earnings or a catalyst can land before expiry (more binary). Orders are entered by hand at the limit or better.
Only 0 of 0 candidates passed today. The rule is not loosened to reach 2; the rest are listed below with the reason they failed.
